Window host + shipped UI runtime and building blocks
Tap thread + delivery machine + interaction registry
+ Machine client (server transport, capability) + tsconfig fragment
Swift side: catalog · resolver · supervisor · transport · evaluator protocol
Script side: lowering · loader · plugin-host · connections
Machine package: engine · Provider contract · Reference · Snapshot · MachineError
Transport + capability model (its design) · LLM skill set
Providers as its plugins: desktop provider first
◆— Composition: app-owned responsibilities, each with narrow modules
Dashed arrow → Dependency: uses an interface or contract
Folder Package boundary; no process/deployment boundary implied

AGREED (plugin-packages-k6): three projects; the framework depends on nothing here, the server embeds the framework, ModalAnyware embeds the framework and is a client of the server from its first increment.
No provider lives in ModalAnyware. A pure TypeScript plugin omits the native executable; no native host SDK is required.
